Bathroom Repairs & Remodels

From a single fixture swap to a full bathroom renovation, plumbed right and built to last.

Get a Quote Call 803-600-4357

What It Is

Bathroom plumbing covers every fixture in the room and the pipes behind them. We handle small repairs and replacements and the plumbing side of a full remodel.

Signs You Need It

  • Toilet that runs, rocks or clogs often
  • Dripping faucet or shower head
  • Shower that won't hold a steady temperature
  • Outdated fixtures you're ready to replace

What To Expect

For a repair, we diagnose the fixture and fix or replace it in the same visit when we can. For a remodel, we plan the layout with you, rough in the new plumbing, and set the fixtures once the room is finished.

Residential Services

What We Handle

  • Toilet Repair & Replacement

    Running, leaking or wobbling toilets waste water and can damage the floor. We repair the inside parts or replace the toilet and seal it properly.

    What's included

    • Fill valve, flapper and flush repairs
    • Wax ring and flange replacement
    • New toilet installation
    • Leak check at the base and supply

    Common signs you need this

    • Toilet runs after flushing
    • Water around the base
    • Toilet rocks when you sit down
    Get a Quote

  • Shower & Tub Valves

    The valve behind the handle controls temperature and flow. We repair or replace worn valves so your shower runs steady and stops dripping.

    What's included

    • Cartridge and valve repair
    • Full valve replacement
    • Shower head and tub spout replacement
    • Temperature and flow check

    Common signs you need this

    • Shower drips after it's turned off
    • Water suddenly goes hot or cold
    • Handle is hard to turn
    Get a Quote

  • Sinks & Faucets

    A new faucet or vanity sink is one of the easiest bathroom upgrades. We install it cleanly and replace the shutoffs and supply lines while we're there.

    What's included

    • Faucet installation and repair
    • Vanity sink installation
    • New shutoff valves and supply lines
    • Drain and trap connections

    Common signs you need this

    • Dripping faucet
    • Low flow from the tap
    • Corroded or stained fixtures
    Get a Quote

  • Full Bathroom Remodels

    A remodel is the time to move fixtures, update old pipe and plan for the layout you want. We handle the plumbing from rough-in through the final fixture set.

    What's included

    • Layout planning for plumbing
    • Rough-in for new fixture locations
    • Updating old supply and drain pipe
    • Final fixture installation

    Common signs you need this

    • Planning a bathroom renovation
    • Adding a bathroom
    • Converting a tub to a walk-in shower
    Get a Quote
